newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian January budget deficit widens vs year-ago.
newsitem.headline: Belgian January budget deficit widens vs year-ago.

text.p: The Belgian federal state's net borrowing requirement widened to 114.8 billion francs in January from 88.3 billion in the year-ago month, the finance and budget ministries said in a statement on Wednesday.
The ministries said the difference was due principally to larger transfers to Belgium's local authorities.
At the end of the month, the amount of spending budgeted but not executed was 3.1 billion Belgian francs compared with 9.9 billion francs in the same year-ago period.
